items.description:
Super Business is a social media marketing agency in Amandasig offering brand strategy, positioning, visual identity and voice systems designed to stand out in a crowded feed, alongside a content studio producing short-form video, reels and photography on a weekly schedule. Its paid social service runs campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube engineered to build a sales pipeline rather than vanity metrics alone.

The agency also provides always-on community management, handling replies, direct messages and creator collaborations, backed by weekly reporting dashboards, cohort analysis and ongoing creative testing. Super Business reports having delivered more than 4.2 billion impressions and an average return on ad spend of 8.7x across more than 120 brands it has scaled, operating from Amandasig, Pretoria.

Synergy Energy Solutions is a renewable-energy and heating installer headquartered in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, trusted since 2010 and now operating with branches in Gauteng, the Western Cape and Limpopo. It designs, supplies, installs and provides aftercare for turnkey solar PV systems, lithium battery storage, EV charging stations, heat-pump water heating and hydronic underfloor heating, working with brands including Tesla, Sigenergy, Victron, Sunsynk, Deye, JA Solar, Canadian Solar, BSL and Freedom Won.

The company is Tesla Certified and Sigenergy Approved, registered with SAPVIA and PV GreenCard, and backs every installation with SANS 10142-1 compliance and a valid Certificate of Compliance. Since 2010 it has completed over 1,700 installations, ranging from small backup power systems for load shedding to off-grid farm systems and hybrid grid-tied solutions for luxury homes, from its Centurion base.

T Sikhala Attorneys is a general legal practice in Arcadia, Pretoria, conveniently situated near the High Court, Magistrates' Court, the Companies Office, the Deeds Office and the Master's Office. The firm's core departments cover consumer and commercial law, contract law and corporate governance, general litigation, dispute resolution and administrative law, as well as legislative drafting, debt collections, property law and the administration of estates.

With more than ten years in practice, the firm also trains its own candidate attorneys and professional assistants, building capacity within the practice rather than relying solely on senior staff. T Sikhala Attorneys operates from Minni Street in Arcadia, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 16:00, with Saturday appointments available on request.

Taste Restaurant Blue Valley is a farm-to-table restaurant and event venue at Blue Valley Golf Estate, using only the finest ingredients and produce in a menu of sumptuous starters, generous mains and delectable desserts, with options for children as well. The venue describes itself around warm, welcoming service and a vibrant atmosphere suited to both impromptu dinners and larger planned events.

Its event planning service covers photography, florist services, event tent hire and catering, along with equipment, crockery and cutlery hire, so clients can arrange a function without needing to coordinate multiple separate suppliers themselves. Taste Restaurant Blue Valley operates from Blue Valley Golf Estate, Centurion, serving diners and event clients from across the surrounding area.

The Good Co is a custom cabinetry and bespoke joinery manufacturer designing, building and installing precision cabinetry and architectural fit-outs for designers, architects and commercial teams across Gauteng. Its process runs from design, turning concepts into technical drawings and 3D models, through manufacture at its Pretoria workshop, to installation on site alongside designers, contractors and site teams.

Past projects include commercial joinery for the Epicure restaurant in Rosebank and the Moonshot Café at Menlyn Maine, residential joinery for a home office in Sandton and a house in Waterkloof, and commercial fit-out work on a South African Reserve Bank renovation in Pretoria. The Good Co operates from its workshop in Derdepoort, Pretoria, serving designers, architects and commercial clients across Gauteng.

The IT Box (Pty) Ltd provides IT support including computer repairs, network setups and remote support for both businesses and home users, describing its approach as making technology simple rather than overwhelming. Its dedicated support team guides clients through everyday technical problems with what the company calls care, clarity and real results.

Beyond routine support, The IT Box offers Judy, an all-in-one cybersecurity service backed by 24/7 Security Operations Centre monitoring against viruses, ransomware and phishing, giving smaller businesses access to the kind of monitoring usually reserved for larger IT departments. The IT Box operates from Olyra Street in Doornpoort, Pretoria, supporting clients by phone, WhatsApp and email as well as on site.

The Kleeners Pest Control & Hygiene is a B-BBEE Level 1, SABS-approved pest control company in Celtisdal treating cockroaches, ants, rodents, bed bugs, termites, fleas, flies, wasps and silverfish, along with microbial fogging for hard-to-reach hygiene problems, for homes, offices, estates, schools and commercial and manufacturing sites. Chemicals used are applied responsibly, and every job comes with a treatment report and recommendations afterwards.

Alongside pest treatment, the company supplies and replenishes washroom dispensers, hygiene equipment, paper consumables and sanitary bins for commercial premises, and offers free quotations with flexible contract terms rather than locking clients into a single package. The Kleeners operates from Fregatvoel Street in Celtisdal, Centurion, serving residential and commercial clients across Gauteng, and holds a 5.0 rating on Google.

The Links Corporate Guest House is an upmarket accommodation property inside the gated Silver Lakes Golf Estate in Pretoria East, offering rooms finished with golf-themed decor for guests who want a quieter, secure setting away from a standard hotel. The property also includes an in-house cinema and secure parking for guests who are staying for business or leisure.

Airport transfer services are available for corporate and international visitors who would rather not arrange their own transport on arrival, making the guest house a practical option for conference or business travel as well as a golfing getaway. The Links Corporate Guest House operates from Gleneagles Drive in Silver Lakes, Pretoria East.

Thogwa Medicals and Pharmaceuticals is a proudly South African distributor of medical and pharmaceutical equipment in Tijger Valley, supplying diagnostic and monitoring gear such as blood pressure monitors, stethoscopes and pulse oximeters alongside dental, physiotherapy and veterinary instruments and disposable medical supplies. Since 2015 the company has positioned itself around servicing the country with quality products while empowering black communities through job creation and skill development.

The company builds strategic partnerships with international manufacturers to bring newer technology into its product range, and works to maintain consistent supply for healthcare practices that depend on reliable stock. Thogwa Medicals and Pharmaceuticals operates from Tyger Valley Office Park in Tijger Valley, Pretoria, serving medical and veterinary practices across the region.

Tiny Homes (Pty) Ltd manufactures and delivers prefab, steel-framed, insulated tiny homes from its Centurion showroom, with seven styles ranging from flat-pack X-Folds from R54,900 to flagship glamping capsules wrapped in 270 degrees of glass from R689,900. Its range also includes expandable homes from R199,900, nature cabins from R810,900, apple cabins from R449,900, outdoor kitchens from R154,400, and custom safari tents built for lodges and other hospitality businesses.

Every home is factory-built and delivered anywhere in South Africa in around 90 days from deposit to move-in, backed by a one-year limited guarantee. Customers can view a unit in person by booking a showroom visit. Tiny Homes operates from Gouws Avenue in Raslouw, Centurion, Monday to Thursday from 08:00 to 16:00 and Fridays from 08:00 to 13:00.

TJ System Integrators (Pty) Ltd, powering industry since 2016, specialises in industrial electrification, automation and critical power infrastructure, including switchgear, UPS and DC power systems, for sectors such as mining, oil and gas, and cement production. The company describes its role as converting, transforming, distributing, protecting, controlling and optimising power for its clients' operations.

A particular focus is fast, reliable emergency support, with the team prioritising equipment supply and rapid response during breakdowns and plant shutdowns to keep operations running rather than leaving clients waiting for a standard service slot. TJ System Integrators operates from Mansfield Avenue in Mayville, Pretoria, serving industrial clients across the region who depend on continuous power.

Touring South Africa is a tour operator running guided South Africa tours, private holidays and custom small-group itineraries since 2004, including Kruger National Park safaris, seasonal Namaqualand flower tours, and trips along the Garden Route, the Karoo, the Drakensberg and into Namibia. Its guided packages also extend further afield to destinations including Israel, Chobe and Victoria Falls, and the Cederberg and West Coast.

Each tour is planned by experienced local guides who keep comfort, adventure and authentic local experiences in mind, offering reliable transport and flexible options for couples, families, friends and international visitors alike. Touring South Africa operates from Buffelsdrift Street in Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, serving travellers seeking small-group or private tours across Southern Africa.

Turf Mobile Panel Beaters is a Centurion-based auto body repair business offering panel beating, spray painting and mobile paintless dent removal for dents, scratches and hail damage, bringing the repair to a customer's home or workplace rather than requiring a drop-off at a workshop. The business also handles wheel-trim and headlight restoration for vehicles showing wear from age or sun exposure.

Beyond cosmetic repairs, the team carries out ABS, ASR and ESP brake-system diagnostics, covering the electronic safety systems found in most modern vehicles rather than panel work alone. Turf Mobile Panel Beaters operates from Samrand Business Park on Sterling Road, Centurion, serving customers across the greater Centurion and Pretoria area.

Tusk Construction Support Services (Pty) Ltd is a multidisciplinary construction management company established in 1997, offering programme and project management, finance management and support, and professional services spanning architectural design, quantity surveying and engineering. The company positions itself as a single operator built to manage every aspect of a building project with a team of highly skilled, professionally registered experts across these disciplines.

Each project begins with a detailed understanding of a client's requirements and risks, resulting in a customised strategy rather than a standard template applied across every job. Tusk Construction Support Services operates from Zircon Street in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, serving clients across the built environment sector.

Ultimate Packaging & Spice supplies packaging materials and spices to caterers, bakers and retailers in Rietfontein, stocking items including cling wrap, foil trays, cake boxes, cake boards and domes, vacuum bags and vacuum pack machines, shrink wrapping equipment, grease-proof and butcher bags, glass and plastic bottles and jars, crates and storage boxes, baking chocolate and moulds, and spices and baking ingredients. The business has traded since 1982 and sells in bulk, wholesale and retail quantities.

Its range extends to party and kids' party supplies, baby shower accessories, serviettes, and cleaning items such as brooms, mops, cloths and brushes, making it a single stop for caterers restocking both food packaging and cleaning supplies. Ultimate Packaging & Spice operates a showroom at 18th Avenue, Rietfontein, Pretoria, with in-store shopping, delivery and curbside pickup available.

United Radiology Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a medical imaging equipment supplier in Hennopspark, distributing United Imaging Healthcare systems covering Magnetic Resonance Imaging, Computed Tomography, digital X-ray, mammography, fluoroscopy, ultrasound, angiography, interventional and molecular imaging equipment, along with CT accessories. The company provides technical support alongside equipment supply, helping hospitals, clinics and imaging centres keep complex imaging machines running.

Supplying this breadth of imaging modalities from a single distributor lets a hospital or clinic standardise its imaging equipment and support relationships rather than dealing with a different supplier for each modality. United Radiology Solutions operates from Jurg Business Park in Hennopspark, Centurion, serving hospitals, clinics and imaging centres across the region.

Valhalla General Dealers is an independent hardware and building-materials store in Valhalla stocking tools, cement, bricks, tiles, paint, plumbing and electrical supplies for homeowners and contractors working on anything from small repairs to full builds. The store also offers glass-cutting, key-cutting and gas-bottle refill services, giving customers a reason to visit beyond standard hardware purchases.

As a member of the Essential Hardware buying group, Valhalla General Dealers can draw on group-wide buying power to keep a wide range of stock available locally rather than operating as a small, limited-range store. The store trades from Angvick Road in Valhalla, Pretoria, Monday to Thursday from 07:30 to 17:00, Friday until 17:30, Saturday from 07:30 to 13:00 and Sunday from 08:00 to 12:00.

Valtran General Transport Contractors is a trucking and logistics company founded in 1975 and operating as a fully B-BBEE company, offering general cargo and structural steel transport, warehousing and part-load services. Its main routes include Botswana, including part loads, alongside cargo warehousing and shipping handled from its own facilities.

The company trucks general cargo, including structural steel, across Limpopo, Mpumalanga, Gauteng, North West Province, the Northern Cape and the Free State, giving it reach across most of South Africa's interior rather than a single regional route. Valtran General Transport Contractors operates from Laudium, Centurion, taking on cargo of any size from its decades of trucking experience.

Vassco Distributors is a wholesale supplier to the hospitality industry in Gauteng, distributing spirits, wines, beers and soft drinks, frozen and grocery food products, and cutlery, crockery, glassware, packaging and cleaning products to restaurants and caterers. The company sources its suppliers from sustainable sources, aiming to offer top-quality brands so that its clients can in turn offer their own customers the best quality and freshness.

Orders can be placed through a call centre, by email or via WhatsApp, with stock delivered to clients daily from Monday to Saturday. Vassco Distributors operates from Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, serving restaurants and caterers across Gauteng who need a single supplier for drinks, food and catering equipment.

Venter & Hagerman Inc is an Alphen Park law firm and firm of conveyancers specialising in Road Accident Fund and medical negligence claims, personal injury matters, deceased estates and the law of contract. The firm also assists clients with wills, trusts, property transfers and divorce proceedings, covering much of the legal work an individual is likely to need across a lifetime.

Combining conveyancing with litigation work means the firm can handle both the transactional side of a property matter and any dispute that follows from it, rather than referring clients elsewhere for one or the other. Venter & Hagerman Inc operates from Garsfontein Road in Alphen Park, Pretoria, serving individual clients across the city.

vida e caffè Southdowns is a branch of Africa's largest privately owned speciality coffee franchise, whose name is Portuguese for 'life and coffee', drawing inspiration from the street cafés of Portugal combined with the energy of Africa. The menu covers coffee, smoothies, juices, hot drinks, breakfast, lunch, snacks and sweet treats, with bespoke blends and single-origin coffees alongside the food range.

The branch caters to vegetarian, vegan, Halal and dairy-free dietary needs where possible, reflecting a customer base the brand describes as being as diverse as its own staff. vida e caffè Southdowns trades from Shop 2, Southdowns Centre, on the corner of John Vorster Drive and Karee Street in Irene, Centurion.

Vleishuys Riviera is a butchery and meat wholesaler on Annie Botha Avenue, Riviera, selling premium beef, lamb, pork and chicken along with cost-effective monthly meat packs. The business promises high-quality meat and exceptional service, continuing a business that has served the Riviera and Moot community for 36 years under new ownership.

Customers rate the butchery highly, with the large majority of reviewers recommending it to others, and the shop maintains an active social media presence showing new stock and specials. Vleishuys Riviera trades Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, Saturdays from 07:00 to 14:00, and on public holidays from 07:00 to 14:00, serving the wider Riviera and Moot area of Pretoria.

WayleaveCENTRAL is a web-based wayleave management platform for municipalities and utility service providers, trusted since 1999 and built to eliminate the inefficiencies, lost paperwork and lack of visibility that come with manual wayleave processes. The platform automates the entire application, review and approval process, giving applicants, contractors, municipalities and service owners real-time communication rather than relying on paper trails that go missing.

Features include online application and tracking, mobile inspection and reporting, TRH26 and TRH27 compliance, system-managed design reviews, and risk and audit trail visibility, with businesses able to see a return on investment in as little as six months. WayleaveCENTRAL counts Tshwane Municipality and Rand Water among its clients, operating from Hazeldean Office Park in Tyger Valley, Pretoria.

Web Maniacs (Pty) Ltd was formed in November 2020 through a merger of two established Pretoria technology and design businesses, bringing together domain and hosting services with branding, creative design and web development under one roof. Today the company serves the combined client base of all three predecessor businesses, offering integrated, all-in-one digital solutions backed by more than 30 years of combined experience in technology, IT support, creative design and web development.

The company builds custom, responsive websites using WordPress and plugins such as Elementor, designed to work well on any device and to be optimised for search engines, alongside branding, social media marketing, domain and hosting services. Web Maniacs operates from Agrihub Business Park in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, serving small businesses, entrepreneurs and growing brands.

A.S.A.P Spares is a new and used auto parts specialist in Hermanstad, Pretoria, founded in 2001 and stocking spares for Opel, Chevrolet, Citroën, Peugeot, Renault, Toyota, Suzuki, Kia, Hyundai and MINI. Every part is inspected before sale, and the business backs its stock with a 30-day guarantee alongside a dedicated team of specialist staff who can help track down harder-to-find parts.

Orders can be placed online, by WhatsApp or by phone, with nationwide delivery through The Courier Guy and same-day dispatch on orders placed before 13:00. A.S.A.P Spares trades from Van Der Hoff Road, Hermanstad, Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00 and Saturdays from 08:00 to 13:00, closed Sundays.

Abdool's Welding is a welding, general work and maintenance company in Eersterust, 100% Black male-owned, handling projects from patio construction and roof painting to industrial and lean-manufacturing work. The company describes itself as committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination based on culture, colour, creed, gender, nationality, marital status, race, and sexual or religious preference.

Beyond contract work, Abdool's Welding focuses on creating job opportunities for youth in its local community and offering learnerships that build skills within the area it operates in, aiming to support the local economy alongside its commercial projects. The company operates from Harding Avenue in Eersterust, Pretoria, Monday to Saturday from 08:00 to 17:00, closed Sundays.

Alers Jungle Gyms has been manufacturing children's jungle gyms since 1989, and its Sunderland Ridge premises serve as the family business's headquarters where customers can view and test equipment such as swings, slides and balancing gear before buying or renting. Customers can rent a jungle gym for a monthly fee rather than committing to a full purchase, or buy one outright with the option to trade in for a bigger model later.

The company also delivers and collects jungle gyms as part of its standard service, and maintains, refurbishes and repairs existing steel jungle gyms that have faded or fallen out of condition. Alers Jungle Gyms operates from Rudolph Street in Sunderland Ridge, Pretoria, Monday to Thursday from 08:00 to 16:30 and Fridays from 08:00 to 15:00.

Annelien Green Accountants is an accounting practice in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, started in 2003 after ten years working in the industry, offering bookkeeping, monthly management accounts, SARS and tax returns, year-end financial statements, payroll, company registration and trust accounting. The practice has been a SAIPA member since 2011, holding a B.Compt qualification and the SAIPA accreditation that comes with it.

Work is handled personally from day-to-day bookkeeping through to final financial statements, giving the practice a complete view of a client's business rather than handling isolated pieces of the accounting picture. The practice has experience serving construction, vehicle sales, property investment and trust clients, operating from Beryl Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, in both Afrikaans and English.

Archetor is a fibre-optic infrastructure and civil construction company established in 2008 and based in Midstream, Centurion, planning and installing fibre-optic network infrastructure for metropolitan areas across South Africa. The company connects thousands of residential and corporate units every year, building the physical network that internet service providers then light up for customers.

Archetor positions its work around reliability and customer satisfaction, combining fibre-optic expertise with ongoing support so that a network stays stable once it is installed rather than requiring repeated repair work. Having connected more than 30,000 homes and commercial developments since its founding, Archetor operates from Midlands Office Park West in Midfields Estate, Centurion, serving the telecommunications industry across the region.

Artistic Ghetto Crafts (AGC) is an urban media and entertainment agency based in Akasia, Pretoria, offering events and talent management, branding, marketing and advertising, and events equipment manufacture and rental. The agency works across both the creative and logistical sides of an event, from booking and managing talent to supplying the equipment an event itself needs.

Its talent division represents musicians, models, actors and athletes, giving the agency a direct pipeline of performers and personalities to draw on for the events and campaigns it manages, rather than needing to source talent externally each time. Artistic Ghetto Crafts operates from Theresa Park Estate in Akasia, Pretoria, serving clients across the entertainment and events industry.

Asgard Power is a generator and solar power systems company in Doornpoort, Pretoria, servicing and maintaining diesel generators from brands including Cummins, Deutz, FAW, John Deere, Lovol, Perkins, Scania, Sdec and Volvo. Proactive servicing and maintenance is central to its approach, aimed at keeping a generator ready to work and diagnosing problems before they become serious rather than only responding after a breakdown.

The company also builds generator control panels to customer specifications, including AMF panels, synchronising panels, base-load panels and key-start panels, drawing on 8 years of experience in panel design and manufacturing. Asgard Power operates from Hamerkop Crescent in Doornpoort, Pretoria, working around a client's business hours to minimise disruption during service visits.

Asteria Pharmaceuticals is a contract manufacturing and formulation house founded in 2003, specialising in bespoke skincare, haircare and supplement products across medical aesthetics, cosmeceuticals, personal care and wellness. The company offers both proprietary formulations for white-label brands and fully customised product development for clients who want a unique product built from scratch.

All products are developed and manufactured in internationally certified facilities under global GMP, ISO and cGMP standards, with a dedicated research and development team working to keep formulations aligned with current cosmeceutical trends. Asteria Pharmaceuticals is also the brand owner of MyGoLean and Resa.K Skin Science, operating from Olympus Boulevard in Pretoria, Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00.

B-earth Paints is a South African manufacturer of certified eco-friendly wall and roof paint systems, with factories in Pretoria, Nelspruit and Cape Town, offering custom-made coatings with 7-year guarantees for surfaces including plaster, concrete, steel, corrugated iron, brick and timber. Its project history spans residential external wall and thatch coatings in Pretoria, boundary wall and steel coatings, and parking area coatings for driveways and parking lots.

The company's coatings have also been used internationally, including salt, fog and UV-resistant wall coatings for a sea-facing property on Bondi Beach, durable road marking paints and floor coatings in Sydney, and insulation roof coatings tested across Gauteng, Mpumalanga and the Western Cape. B-earth Paints operates from Heila Road in Wolmaranspoort, Rietondale, Pretoria, supplying coatings for residential, commercial and industrial projects.

Basumi Projects, established in 2009, is a plumbing, electrical and property maintenance company based in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, offering repairs and installations from geyser and aircon work to blocked drains and house wiring, with a 24-hour emergency service for urgent breakdowns. The business operates as part of a wider property maintenance group that also includes fire protection services for businesses, factories and residential estates.

This group structure gives Basumi Projects access to a broader base of maintenance expertise and resources than a standalone plumbing and electrical business would typically have on its own. Basumi Projects operates from 12th Avenue in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, serving homeowners and businesses across the northern Pretoria suburbs who need plumbing, electrical or general property maintenance.

BEAL Travel is a tour operator based in Hazeldean, part of the BEAL Group, specialising in sports, schools, heritage and incentive tours with a track record of more than 1,500 tours and 60,000 travellers. Its sports travel offering includes supporter tours for events such as the United Rugby Championship and the European Challenge Cup, tailor-made to each group of supporters.

The company also runs inbound and outbound tours for schools and sports clubs, combining sport, culture and sightseeing so that students experience their own or another country in a structured, educational way, alongside incentive travel programmes that reward staff and teams for businesses. BEAL Travel operates from Tijger Vallei Office Park in Hazeldean, Pretoria, drawing on tour managers with years of local experience.

BEE Transformation Solutions is a SANAS-accredited B-BBEE verification agency, accreditation number BVA274, based in Midstream, established in 2018 and accredited in 2020. Its verification team includes experts on B-BBEE legislation, codes and the various sector charters, supported by administrative staff who manage the process from a client's initial request through to the issuing of a B-BBEE certificate.

The agency is accredited across multiple sectoral codes including financial services, ICT, agriculture, tourism, construction, transport, road freight, maritime, and forwarding and clearing, as well as rail, giving it the scope to verify businesses across most major South African industries. BEE Transformation Solutions operates from Midlands Office Park West in Midstream Estate, Centurion, serving clients who need an accurate, accredited verification.

BluSwirl Recycling, founded in 2010 in Sunderland Ridge, provides eco-friendly waste management including garden refuse removal, on- and off-site sorting of paper, glass, plastic and cans, e-waste disposal, and branded wheelie bins for commercial and private clients. The company was built around a focus on reliable, objective-driven service rather than treating waste collection as a purely transactional job.

Its recycling services are designed to be flexible, letting clients choose between on-site sorting or sending waste off-site for sorting elsewhere, with rates aimed at keeping the service affordable for both households and businesses. BluSwirl currently operates in Centurion, working from Ellman Street in Sunderland Ridge and serving clients across the area who need ongoing waste management rather than a once-off clean-up.

Boardwalk Manor Security Estate in Faerie Glen is one of the Boardwalk Estates, a group of security estates developed along the Tweefontein Spruit, a tributary of the Moreleta Spruit, and named for the boardwalk theme that runs through the area's design. Its landscaped gardens, fountains and statues have been compared to a charming Italian village, and the estate won a Gold Award of Excellence in the South African Landscapers Institute Awards.

The estate offers access control, electrified perimeter security, a tennis court, a squash court, a pool and a children's play area, alongside prolific birdlife and direct access to the adjoining Boardwalk Bird Sanctuary. Boardwalk Manor Security Estate is located off Boardwalk Boulevard in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, offering a range of property types within a single secure estate.

Braddick Aerospace, trading as Braddick Specialised Air Services, is an aerospace engineering firm based at Hangar 11, Wonderboom Airport, grounded in South African aviation engineering and known for high-spec defence work and precision manufacturing. The company has built a reputation for its DC-3/C-47 turbine conversions, fitting older airframes with Pratt & Whitney PT6 turboprop engines rather than retiring them.

Established in 2008, the company's work spans both local and international aircraft modification and engineering projects, giving it experience beyond the South African market alone. Braddick Aerospace operates from Wonderboom Airport in Pretoria North, serving operators who need specialised aircraft modification, engineering or defence-related aviation work carried out in South Africa.

Broll Property Group is an international real estate services firm operating since 1975 across 37 countries in Africa, providing property management, commercial real estate advisory and leasing, and facilities management services. The company's mission centres on building a high-performance, respectful and dynamic culture that supports trusted relationships both internally and with the clients it serves.

Broll's facilities management division has been recognised industry-wide, including a Silver award for facilities excellence at the PMR Golden Arrow Awards, and the group supports the Reach For A Dream Foundation, helping children with life-threatening illnesses. This branch of Broll Property Group operates from the Southdowns Shopping Centre in Irene, Pretoria, managing property and leasing for clients in the surrounding area.

Business and Auction Academy is an online training provider for South Africa's real estate industry, offering courses such as an Estate Agents Logbook, PDE4 exam preparation, and workshops on the Property Practitioner Bill aimed at estate agents and property practitioners. The academy positions itself as an e-learning pioneer, delivering its courses through its own e-learning platform rather than in-person classes alone.

Its stated mission is to provide quality educational experiences and support services that lead students through both the academic and practical sides of qualifying as a property practitioner, in a learning environment it describes as safe, accessible and affordable. Business and Auction Academy operates from an office park in Tijger Vallei, Pretoria, serving estate agents and property practitioners studying towards their qualifications.

Business Compliancy Administrators, based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, is a B-BBEE compliance consultancy established in 2016 offering B-BBEE consulting, file preparation and verification assistance, occupational health and safety SHE file preparation and training, and employment equity plans and submissions to the Department of Labour. The company also reviews and implements human resources policies and procedures for client businesses.

A further service covers writing and monitoring Supplier Development and Enterprise Development plans tailored to a client's sector requirements, along with procurement analysis aimed at maximising B-BBEE points and ownership solutions through structures such as Employee Ownership Trusts and Key Person Trusts. The company states it has assisted over 571 companies with B-BBEE compliance matters, operating from Pec Business Park in Silvertondale, Pretoria.

Business Furniture Solutions is a South African office furniture company offering desks, boardroom and meeting tables, seating including Herman Miller chairs, storage systems, and pods and acoustic booths for break-away spaces and meeting rooms with poor acoustics. The company also provides office planning and installation services, working from floorplans through to a final fit-out for a client's workspace.

An online shop lets customers order popular furniture items directly for delivery without needing a full planning consultation, for smaller orders or straightforward replacements. Business Furniture Solutions' Pretoria office, in Villieria, operates by appointment, serving businesses across Pretoria that are furnishing or re-planning an office, call centre or boardroom.

Business Partners Limited is a South African SME finance provider offering business finance from R250,000 to R50 million, property finance, asset finance, and short-term working capital loans from R250,000 to R750,000 repayable over 18 months. The company has been operating since 1981 and has approved over R26 billion in finance across more than 73,000 business finance transactions.

Its product range includes the Basadi-Women Growth Fund, offering R250,000 to R5 million for women-owned SMEs, and an SME Youth Jobs Fund offering R250,000 to R2 million to fund labour costs for newly created jobs, alongside mentorship for entrepreneurs. Business Partners was named 2019 Gold winner for SME Bank of the Year - Africa at the Global SME Finance Awards, and is a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor, operating from Erasmuskloof, Pretoria.

Cafe Kremetart is a small, women-run cafe on the grounds of the NG Church in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, serving coffee and light meals in a family-friendly setting, with a signature carrot cake among its best-known items. The cafe offers brunch, lunch and desserts with both dine-in and takeaway options, and is not visible from the road, reached instead via the church entrance.

Guests can make use of outdoor seating, free WiFi and NFC mobile payments, and the cafe accepts reservations and offers delivery for those who cannot visit in person. Cafe Kremetart holds a 4.6 out of 5 rating from its reviewers, trading from the corner of Kameeldrift Weg and Sinagoge Road in Kameeldrif, Roodeplaat, Pretoria.

Cape Union Mart is a South African outdoor gear and clothing retailer, founded in 1933, selling hiking, camping, travel and adventure equipment including its own K-Way and Old Khaki brands. The chain has grown into one of the country's best-known outdoor retailers, stocking everything from technical hiking boots and tents to everyday travel clothing.

This branch operates from Shop 90 in Irene Village Mall, Van Ryneveld Avenue, Irene Farm Villages, Centurion, trading Monday to Thursday from 09:00 to 19:00, Friday from 09:00 to 20:00, Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 17:00, giving shoppers extended hours on Fridays ahead of the weekend.

items.reason: Own site (carrs.csir.co.za) is a login portal with no public information about what CARRS does or offers; search results returned only unrelated phone-contract and sports-league pages because the acronym collides with other terms. The current description already states this lack of information; no new facts were found to expand it to 100+ honest words.

items.description:
Chatz Connect - Midstream, at Shop 21 in Square@Midstream, is an independent dealer exclusive to Vodacom, part of a network of over 165 Chatz Connect stores nationwide. The store sells smartphone contracts across the Vodacom range, helping customers pick a device and a plan suited to their usage rather than choosing a handset without matching cover.

Beyond new contracts, the branch also offers services such as upgrades for existing Vodacom customers and battery replacements for older devices, giving customers a reason to return to the store beyond their initial purchase. Chatz Connect - Midstream operates from Brakfontein Road in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, serving residents of the estate and surrounding areas.

Citadel Investment Services is a wealth management firm founded in 1993, offering investment advice, asset management, fiduciary services, estate planning and family office services to individuals and families building and protecting their wealth. The firm manages combined assets of over R432 billion, giving it scale that smaller independent wealth managers in the region typically do not have.

As an authorised financial services provider, Citadel structures its advice around a client's full financial picture rather than a single product, from day-to-day investment management through to planning the transfer of wealth between generations. Citadel's Pretoria office operates from the Kaaimans Building at Lynnwood Bridge Office Park in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, serving clients across the city.

Citistone, previously known as New Northwest, is a property management company with 23 years of expertise handling sectional title administration, rental management, facilities management, and property brokering for residential, commercial and shopping centre clients. Its portfolio managers are PPRA certified and hold a Fidelity Fund Certificate, and the wider team has an average tenure of 10 years, reflecting low staff turnover.

This combination of certified portfolio managers and long-serving staff gives clients continuity in who manages their property, rather than a frequently changing point of contact. Citistone is headquartered at Tijger Valley Office Park in Pretoria, with a second office in Johannesburg, managing sectional titles, homeowners associations and a small portfolio of shopping centres.
